raw_sections.experience:
Professional Experience:
1. GARMIN, October 2022 - Present (Software Engineer 2)
To build a private cloud solution for internal Garmin users which help them to create resources like
servers, databases and request for firewalls which are all in one click using a web platform.
2. Cognizant, May 2021 – October 2022 (Associate Consultant)
To build microservices to transfer and store the different types of data which is in the format of IDOC, xml, json, csv between two systems. The RESTful API’s are built using spring boot and apache camel which uses a routing logic to fetch and manipulate the data from source system like S4Hana and push the data into kafka topics and finally send them to target systems of various clients.
3. Capgemini India Private Limited, Feb 2018 – May 2021 (Associate Consultant)
Alerts: This project is to build microservices to consume the events related to payments and process them and publish them into kafka topics, do further business processing using java spring boot and hit external RESTful API’s to send alerts to the users which are push notifications, emails and SMS. The project is implemented using Event driven architecture and kafka.
Responsibilities:
API development • Debugging and Bug Resolving • Thorough unit testing • Deployment to cloud environment • Product level Production defect fixing • Given sprint demo to client where business people are involved • Conducted defect meetings • Active participation in Sprint planning and grooming to have a clear understanding of requirements and what needed to be delivered.
